item.title: Strong cold front Sunday delivers storms, wind, and winter cold
item.description: A cold front will bring a weekend of warm weather, followed by a strong cold front on Sunday, leading to a cold snap with temperatures dipping below 20° on Monday, before warming up again by Thursday.
